functions.name: QUESTIONS
functions.description: Spills a table of questions (id, name, headline prob, 24h change, number of rungs, headline rung), biggest 24h movers first.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Optional text the question name must contain, e.g. "taiwan". Empty = all.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Optional entity name or id, e.g. "Iran": only questions involving it.

parameters.name: factor
parameters.description: Optional factor id, e.g. "brent" or "credit_us_hy": only questions linked to this factor.

parameters.name: industry
parameters.description: Optional GICS industry code, e.g. "453010" (Semiconductors): only questions reachable via that industry's niche factors. Get codes from ER.INDUSTRIES.

functions.name: ENTITY
functions.description: Spills the questions involving a country, person or organisation (id, name, prob, 24h change, status, 24h volume, rungs), live and most traded first.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Entity name, e.g. "Iran" or "Xi Jinping" (or a Wikidata id such as wd:Q794).

functions.name: PROB
functions.description: Probability (0-1). q: = the question's headline rung (most-traded live rung; it can switch), prop: = one rung blended across venues, mkt: = one venue's own price.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Id from ER.QUESTIONS, ER.RUNGS or ER.CONTRACTS: question (q:...), rung (prop:...) or venue contract (mkt:...).

functions.name: CHANGE
functions.description: 24-hour change in probability of a proposition or a question's headline rung (e.g. 0.05 = +5 points).

functions.name: NAME
functions.description: The wording of a question, rung or venue contract, e.g. "Will China blockade Taiwan?"

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Id from ER.QUESTIONS, ER.RUNGS or ER.CONTRACTS: question (q:...), rung (prop:...) or venue contract (mkt:...).

functions.name: FIELD
functions.description: One detail of a question, rung or venue contract: name, prob, status, volume_24h, open_interest, updated, close_time (dates as Excel dates); questions also headline, headline_id, n_rungs, n_live, venues; rungs also question, n_markets, venues; contracts (mkt:) also title, rules, rules_secondary, resolution_sources, outcomes, venue, match.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Id from ER.QUESTIONS, ER.RUNGS or ER.CONTRACTS: question (q:...), rung (prop:...) or venue contract (mkt:...).

functions.name: RUNGS
functions.description: Spills a question's ladder: one row per rung (id, name, deadline, threshold, prob, 24h change, status, headline), latest deadline first.

functions.name: CONTRACTS
functions.description: Spills the venue contracts behind a question (its live rungs) or a rung: id, venue, name, rung, relation (same_as = blended; near_equivalent = similar, not blended), prob, 24h volume, open interest, updated, close time, rules.

functions.name: HISTORY
functions.description: Restated probability over time (date, prob, n_markets): today's contracts for the rung applied to every past day. A q: id uses its current headline rung.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Optional start date. Default 30 days before end; must be on or before end.

functions.name: CURVE
functions.description: Spills a deadline question's term structure: per deadline, the probability by then (market and monotone fit), the probability in that period, the same conditional on not before, and the annualized hazard rate.

parameters.name: question_id
parameters.description: Question id (q:...) of a deadline question.

functions.name: PROB_BY
functions.description: Probability the event happens by a date (e.g. before a bond matures), from a deadline question's fitted curve.

parameters.name: question_id
parameters.description: Question id (q:...) of a deadline question.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: The date, e.g. a maturity date cell.

parameters.name: extrapolate
parameters.description: Optional: TRUE to extend the last period's hazard past the last deadline.

functions.name: FACTORS
functions.description: Spills the factors a question is relevant to with the measured sensitivity: factor move per +1.0 of probability (beta, in the factor's units % or bp), standard error, per 10 points, move if it resolved YES / NO now, events measured, latest level.

functions.name: FACTOR
functions.description: A factor's latest level (default) or a field: level, level_date, name, layer (macro|niche), family, units, series, definition.

parameters.name: factor_id
parameters.description: Factor id, e.g. credit_us_hy or brent.

functions.name: SENSITIVITY
functions.description: Factor move per +1.0 of the question's probability (shrunk estimate), in the factor's units (% or bp).

functions.name: STRESS
functions.description: P&L if the question resolved now: sum of loading x factor move if YES (or NO). Loadings = your P&L per 1% (or per 1 bp) of each factor; computed in Excel, never sent anywhere.

parameters.name: loadings
parameters.description: Range of loadings, same size: P&L per 1% or per 1 bp of each factor.

functions.name: INDUSTRIES
functions.description: Spills GICS industries (id, name, code, sector, industry_group, n_issuers, n_factors). Use the code in ER.QUESTIONS industry filter or ER.ISSUERS to find issuers in a sector.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Optional name or sector fragment, e.g. "Semiconductor" or "Energy".

parameters.name: sector
parameters.description: Optional exact GICS sector name, e.g. "Information Technology".

functions.name: ISSUERS
functions.description: Spills a table of issuers (id, name, country, sector, sub_industry, n_exposures). Optionally filter by name fragment. Use the id in ER.EXPOSURES.

functions.name: EXPOSURES
functions.description: Spills an issuer's event exposures: question id, name, prob, 24h change, score (relevance 0-1), impact (signed: + = issuer benefits if YES), direction and risk (|impact| × √(p(1−p))). Sorted by risk by default.

parameters.name: issuer_id
parameters.description: Issuer id from ER.ISSUERS, e.g. iss:Q713418.

functions.name: SECURITIES
functions.description: Spills the top securities with a measured sensitivity to a question: ticker, name, issuer, beta (% move per +1.0 probability), move if YES/NO at the current price, and number of events measured.

functions.name: LOADINGS
functions.description: Spills a security's factor loadings: factor id, name, units, beta (weekly % move per unit factor move, controlling for the market), se, t-stat and whether |t| ≥ 3. Rows with |t| ≥ 3 listed first.

parameters.name: ticker
parameters.description: Security ticker, e.g. TSM or AAPL.

functions.name: SECURITY_EXPOSURES
functions.description: Spills the questions a security moves with (measured betas): question id, name, prob, 24h change, beta, move if YES/NO, risk and found_by (factor / structural / both).

functions.name: FACTOR_SECURITIES
functions.description: Spills securities with a measured loading on a factor, largest |t| first: ticker, name, issuer, units, beta, se, t-stat, significant (|t| ≥ 3).

parameters.name: factor_id
parameters.description: Factor id, e.g. brent or credit_us_hy.

functions.name: FACTOR_HISTORY
functions.description: Spills daily levels of a factor (date, level) in its units (% for indices and FX, bp for credit spreads and yields). Default: the last year.

parameters.name: factor_id
parameters.description: Factor id, e.g. brent or equity_us.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Optional start date. Default one year before end.
